$comment: Shared Go/TypeScript case table for the status-override provenance line the checklist exporter writes into a vuln's COMMENTS (shared/go/checklist/from_hdf.go formatOverride and shared/typescript/checklist/from-hdf.ts formatOverride). Every case is run by both languages against the public HDFToChecklist / hdfToChecklist entry point, and wantComments pins the whole string, so the two exporters cannot drift on the prose a .ckl consumer reads. The Go zero time is the load-bearing case: a Go-serialized override carries 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z for an unset timestamp, Go's IsZero guards drop the clause entirely, and a raw read renders a year-1 instant into the COMMENTS text.

cases.name: the Go zero time on both timestamps renders neither clause
cases.note: What a Go-serialized override carries for unset timestamps; Go's IsZero guards omit both, so the TypeScript peer must not render year-1 instants a reader would take for real dates.
cases.wantComments: Override [waiver]: Vendor support contract renewed; waiver recorded in the SSP. (by isso@example.test)

results.codeDesc: System Package redhat-release should be installed

statusOverrides.reason: Vendor support contract renewed; waiver recorded in the SSP.
